remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks. "1." on verso inscription most probably indicates first work in series. See cat. nos. 195, 196, 1796. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: Watercolor on rough laid paper. Blue mountains with patches of white snow rise above a hillside covered in clusters of red flowers. The dark green branches of pine trees stretch into the composition from its edges.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
